basic_details.job_title: NHSRC Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Senior Consultant & Project Analyst Posts
basic_details.post_name: Senior Consultant - Family Planning, Project Analyst (RCH)

age_limit.details: Senior Consultant - Upper Limit 55 years Project Analyst - Maximum Age Limit: 60 years for all posts. Age relaxation will be as per government rules.

qualification.education_qualification: MBBS/ BDS/ BHMS/ BAMS/ BPT + MD/ MPH/ MHA/ Post Graduate Diploma in Health Management/ MBA in Health Management, M.A / M.Sc. / M.Com. / MBA
qualification.details: Senior Consultant - Family Planning: MBBS/BDS/BHMS/BAMS/BPT + MD/MPH/MHA/Post Graduate Diploma in Health Management/MBA in Health Management with minimum 5+ years experience in public health of which 2-3 years in RCH. Project Analyst (RCH): M.A / M.Sc. / M.Com. / MBA from a recognized University or Institute with at least 5 years work experience in government sector at national/state levels.

salary_details.details: Senior Consultant - Rs.90,000/- to Rs.1,50,000/- per month. Project Analyst - Rs.60,000/- to Rs.1,20,000/- on the basis of qualifications and experience

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NHSRC Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 18-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NHSRC to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the NHSRC Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download NHSRC Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Senior Consultant - Family Planning: MBBS/BDS/BHMS/BAMS/BPT + MD/MPH/MHA/Post Graduate Diploma in Health Management/MBA in Health Management with minimum 5+ years experience in public health of which 2-3 years in RCH. Project Analyst (RCH): M.A / M.Sc. / M.Com. / MBA from a recognized University or Institute with at least 5 years work experience in government sector at national/state levels.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Senior Consultant - Upper Limit 55 years Project Analyst - Maximum Age Limit: 60 years for all posts. Age relaxation will be as per government rules.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Recruitment 2026 - Salary
content_sections.text: Senior Consultant - Rs.90,000/- to Rs.1,50,000/- per month. Project Analyst - Rs.60,000/- to Rs.1,20,000/- on the basis of qualifications and experience

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: Written Test (if applicable, minimum 70% qualifying marks)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NHSRC Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 18-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NHSRC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NHSRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the NHSRC Recruitment 2026 is 18th August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the post names for which NHSRC is recruiting?
faq.answer: NHSRC is recruiting for the posts of Senior Consultant - Family Planning and Project Analyst (RCH) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Senior Consultant - Family Planning?
faq.answer: For the Senior Consultant - Family Planning post, candidates need MBBS/BDS/BHMS/BAMS/BPT along with MD/MPH/MHA/Post Graduate Diploma in Health Management/MBA in Health Management and at least 5 years of experience in public health.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the NHSRC posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts announced under NHSRC Recruitment 2026 is 60 years.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for NHSRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, as per the available information, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates applying for the NHSRC Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for these positions will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 60,000/- to Rs. 1,50,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available in this NHSRC recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced in this NHSRC recruitment drive, with one post for Senior Consultant - Family Planning and one for Project Analyst (RCH).

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for NHSRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process for NHSRC Recruitment 2026 is entirely online. Candidates must submit their applications through the official website or the provided application link.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for NHSRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process may include a Written Test, for which a minimum qualifying mark of 70% is required. Further details will be provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for NHSRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF for NHSRC Recruitment 2026 can be downloaded from the Important Links section provided on this page, or directly from the NHSRC official website.
